sources.title: Qwen3-8B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened for the parameter re-audit: the exact Qwen3-8B post-trained model card still reports 8.2B total and 6.95B non-embedding parameters; the latter is not an activated count. Native context is 32768, with 131072 using YaRN.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: April 29, 2025 launch explicitly includes Qwen3-8B among six dense open-weight models under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened exact configuration: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, hidden size 4096, 32 query / 8 KV heads and untied embeddings. It agrees with the published dense architecture; no expert expansion or added modality is identified.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: The architecture section identifies Qwen3-8B as dense. Tables 17 and 18 explicitly publish 8B activated parameters for the exact post-trained model in both thinking and non-thinking comparisons, correcting the previous audit conclusion.

sources.title: Qwen3 official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen3 as developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud; release history records April 29, 2025.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint repository contains Apache License Version 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report — Table 17, thinking models
sources.evidence: The Qwen3-8B column lists dense architecture and nominal 8B under both activated and total parameter rows.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report — Table 18, non-thinking models
sources.evidence: The exact Qwen3-8B column independently lists nominal 8B activated parameters in non-thinking mode, matching Table 17.

patch.description: Dense 8.2B Qwen3 model with switchable thinking for chat, reasoning, and tool use
patch.notes: 8.2B is the developer-rounded total; the technical report publishes nominal 8B activated parameters in both thinking and non-thinking mode. The 6.95B non-embedding count is separate. Native context is 32768 tokens; 131072 requires YaRN. The model card explains the default 40960 positional allocation.

summary: Fresh model-card, configuration, release-post and technical-report checks retain 8.2B total and dense architecture. Previously missed Tables 17 and 18 disclose nominal 8B activated parameters for exact Qwen3-8B, resolving the active-count null. The arXiv version-history check found no newer report revision; remaining uncertainty is only finer active-count precision.
